aboutText: Tony Handyman & Fencing is your trusted home repair partner in Sunshine North, Melbourne. We specialise in a wide range of services including kitchen and bathroom renovations, flooring, skirting, painting, door repairs, and custom fencing. With years of experience serving the local community, we deliver professional and reliable solutions for both residential and commercial properties.
servicesText: From minor fixes to major renovations, Tony Handyman & Fencing offers comprehensive repair services. We cover everything from indoor handyman tasks to outdoor fencing projects, ensuring high-quality workmanship and customer satisfaction.
